'''''Atropellado de coco''''' is a traditional Yucatecan dessert, containing coconut and sweet potato.

== Ingredients ==
*[[Cookbook:Sweet Potato|Sweet potato]]
*[[Cookbook:Sugar|Sugar]]
*[[Cookbook:Cinnamon|Cinnamon]]
*Water
*Ground [[Cookbook:Coconut|coconut]]

== Procedure ==

# Bake or steam sweet potato until soft, then mash it.
# Combine sugar, cinnamon, and water over medium-low heat to make a syrup.
# Combine the sweet potato mash and sugar syrup.
# Mix in ground coconut until it forms a workable [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]].
# Form dough into balls or other shapes and serve.
